def format_weight(grams: int, unit: str = "kg") -> str:
    """Weight for display on labels, slips and the storefront. unit is "kg" (default), "g" or "lb":
    kg drops trailing zeros (1500 -> "1.5 kg"), g is whole grams ("250 g"), lb has two decimals

    return f"{round(grams / 1000, 2):g} kg"

    number: int

    @property
    def item_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(q for _, q in self.items)


def consolidate_lines(order: Order) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    by_sku = group_by(order.lines, key=lambda line: line.sku)
    return [(sku, sum(line.qty for line in lines)) for sku, lines in by_sku.items()]


def plan_parcels(order: Order, max_items: int = 10) -> list[Parcel]:
    items = consolidate_lines(order)
    chunks = chunked(items, max_items)
    return [Parcel(order.id, i, chunk) for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks, 1)]


def parcel_summary(parcel: Parcel) -> str:
    return f"{parcel.item_count} items"
